answer: Each identity binds a unique copper-weighted stake to a sequential timber-chain of proofs that must be rebuilt from a private whisper of nonce material every epoch. A farm of N sybils cannot share the sequential work%2C so they pay N times the 45-minute rebuild cost plus N*50 copper units locked%3B an honest agent pays once. If the whisper entropy falls below 128 bits the chain becomes forgeable by colluding clones.
